subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept editable Control UI composer dictation as a Gateway/provider-backed feature via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027, or should this stay under the broader WebChat voice direction?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new core web/Gateway audio UX with security and provider-routing implications, so automation should not choose the permanent product boundary while an implementation PR is already open.

options.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide the Gateway/provider-backed implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 before starting any separate repair work.

options.title: Fold into the broader voice tracker
options.body: Close or retarget the narrow issue only after maintainers decide that editable dictation should be handled inside https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 instead.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Decline the core feature and ask contributors to keep voice input outside core until a future web/Gateway audio direction is approved.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide the Gateway/provider-backed implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 before starting any separate repair work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the earlier server-side dictation implementation and has recent ownership signals in the current chat composer path.
